# s284 — ai relay tells the orchestrator to record each step with relay-run

`slicer ai relay` tells the orchestrator to call `relay-run begin` when a relay starts, `relay-run step` as each role and subagent starts and finishes, and `relay-run end` at the close, so the board has data without extra prompting.

**Findings:** owner request, session 2026-10-14: monitor slice relays from the TUI · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** the agents repo playbook (`multi-agent-workflows/playbooks/slice-relay.md`), which is outside this repository; the owner updates it separately.

## Why

The ledger is only as good as the orchestrator's recording. `relay_text` (`src/slicer/ai.py:248`) is the relay contract the orchestrator reads, so the recording steps belong there, next to the role order in `RELAY_ORDER` (line 196).
